title: Renovated, Convenient, and Cozy: The Stella James
description:
This apartment is centrally located in an area perfect for those wanting to stay near the cultural heartbeat of music city. It's situated conveniently near Music Row, Vanderbilt and Belmont Universities, Edgehill Village, Hillsboro Village, 12 South, and the Gulch/Downtown. 

You'll enjoy 2 bedrooms (1 queen bed & 2 twin beds). High speed internet, cable, 2 televisions, and a washer/dryer make you feel instantly at home.

The space
The Stella James is ready to welcome you and your guests to Music City, USA.  The apartment is 675 square feet, but open and decorated with your comfort and convenience in mind.  Features like charging stations, fully appointed kitchen, and washer and dryer make it perfect for those traveling for business or a fun weekend getaway.

Guest access
The entire apartment is available for your use.  An electronic keypad on the front door allows easy access in and out of the apartment.

Other things to note
Please note the apartment is located in a multi-unit complex.  We ask you respect those living on either side of the apartment.
